race.title: BAR 1 Casino 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: NORMAN PRINCE caught the eye with his finishing effort when runner-up in a French bumper and can make a winning start over hurdles having since joined the Gigginstown/Elliott team. Fellow hurdling newcomers Huff'n'puff and Sunrush are also much respected on the strength of their Flat form. NORMAN PRINCE (FR) HUFF'N'PUFF SUNRUSH (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Norman Prince (15/8), Huff'n'puff (3/1), Green Soul (4/1), Mergus Serrator (9/2), Sunrush (6/1), Nustty (18/1), Glen Echo (33/1), Nephin Mountain (66/1), Fay Og (125/1), Arizona Star (125/1), Rose Sienna (125/1), Matada (200/1), Courtlough Gula (300/1), Star Of Tara (300/1), Moon Aura (500/1)
